title: Manage your organization
summary: Create and manage organizations in Matrix, with a cleaner view for people working alone.

highlights.title: Organization management
highlights.body: Manage your organization and its members from the browser or the desktop app.

items.text: If you're not in an organization, organization-only options stay out of your way.
Agent failures show a short, actionable explanation.
The mobile app prompts you when an update is ready.
Shared project chats stay consistent for everyone.
Saved bots open in their own conversation.
